comments.text:
Summary:
Convert get_transactions with optional filters and robust validation.

Implementation Notes:

- Args: optional account_id (string), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (int, max 500)
- Query joins(:account).where(accounts.family_id = family_id); apply filters; includes(:category) to avoid N+1
- Output: [{id, date ISO8601, amount string, name, category}]
- Validate date order (start <= end) and limit bounds

Tasks:

1. Implement FastMcp::Tool subclass with argument validations
2. Apply limit capping; parse dates
3. Register tool; add integration tests for filters and bounds

Acceptance Criteria:

- Correct filtering; limit enforced; invalid date range errors
- P95 under 500ms on 10k txn dataset (baseline)

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-13, SFMCP-21, SFMCP-25 (perf follow-up)

Huly Issue: SFMCP-80

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=merge for Categories.

Payload

- source_id (uuid, required)
- target_id (uuid, required)

Rules

- Same family and classification
- Move all transactions from source to target
- Rewire budget_categories; handle unique(budget_id, category_id)
- Destroy source after move

Result

- { ok: true, result: { merged: true, moved_transactions: N, moved_budget_categories: M } }

Errors

- conflict (budget category uniqueness)
- validation_error (classification mismatch)
- not_found (ids)

Tests

- Happy: merge two expense categories; merge two income categories
- Edge: classification mismatch rejected; budget_category conflict resolved gracefully

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1895

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Summary:
Convert get_transactions with optional filters and robust validation.

Implementation Notes:

- Args: optional account_id (string), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (int, max 500)
- Query joins(:account).where(accounts.family_id = family_id); apply filters; includes(:category) to avoid N+1
- Output: [{id, date ISO8601, amount string, name, category}]
- Validate date order (start <= end) and limit bounds

Tasks:

1. Implement FastMcp::Tool subclass with argument validations
2. Apply limit capping; parse dates
3. Register tool; add integration tests for filters and bounds

Acceptance Criteria:

- Correct filtering; limit enforced; invalid date range errors
- P95 under 500ms on 10k txn dataset (baseline)

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-13, SFMCP-21, SFMCP-25 (perf follow-up)

comments.text:

**Options to evaluate:**

1. Direct database connection (share database.yml)
2. Extract models to shared gem
3. API calls to Rails app
4. Direct model copying

- Access to Account, Transaction, Budget, Holding models
- Respect Current.family scoping
- Handle multi-currency data
- Read-only access initially

**Decision needed:** Which integration approach to use

**Dependencies:** SFMCP-2 (project structure)

Huly Issue: SFMCP-388

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

Huly Issue: SFMCP-176

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

Huly Issue: SFMCP-477

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Summary:
Convert get_transactions with optional filters and robust validation.

Implementation Notes:

- Args: optional account_id (string), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (int, max 500)
- Query joins(:account).where(accounts.family_id = family_id); apply filters; includes(:category) to avoid N+1
- Output: [{id, date ISO8601, amount string, name, category}]
- Validate date order (start <= end) and limit bounds

Tasks:

1. Implement FastMcp::Tool subclass with argument validations
2. Apply limit capping; parse dates
3. Register tool; add integration tests for filters and bounds

Acceptance Criteria:

- Correct filtering; limit enforced; invalid date range errors
- P95 under 500ms on 10k txn dataset (baseline)

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-13, SFMCP-21, SFMCP-25 (perf follow-up)

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1848

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=move for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- new_parent_id (uuid|null, required)

Rules

- Enforce depth <= 2 and classification match
- Cross-family forbidden
- Update color inheritance for moved subtree

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (depth limit, classification mismatch)
- not_found (ids)
- forbidden (cross-family)

Tests

- Happy: move root -> child of root; child -> root
- Edge: attempt to create third-level rejected; move to other-family parent rejected

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1714

title: Define initial MCP tools for financial data access

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Design and document the initial set of MCP tools that the server will expose.

**Proposed Tools:**

1.  - List all accounts with balances
2.  - Query transactions with filters (date range, account, category)
3.  - Time series balance data for charts
4.  - Full-text search across transactions
5.  - List budgets with spending vs targets
6.  - List transaction categories

**Considerations:**

- Authentication/authorization (family scope)
- Rate limiting
- Pagination for large result sets
- Date range filtering
- Currency handling

**Deliverable:** Tool definitions document in BookStack

**Options to evaluate:**

1. Direct database connection (share database.yml)
2. Extract models to shared gem
3. API calls to Rails app
4. Direct model copying

**Requirements:**

- Access to Account, Transaction, Budget, Holding models
- Respect Current.family scoping
- Handle multi-currency data
- Read-only access initially

**Decision needed:** Which integration approach to use

**Dependencies:** SFMCP-2 (project structure)

title: Define initial MCP tools for financial data access

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Design and document the initial set of MCP tools that the server will expose.

**Proposed Tools:**

1.  - List all accounts with balances
2.  - Query transactions with filters (date range, account, category)
3.  - Time series balance data for charts
4.  - Full-text search across transactions
5.  - List budgets with spending vs targets
6.  - List transaction categories

**Considerations:**

- Authentication/authorization (family scope)
- Rate limiting
- Pagination for large result sets
- Date range filtering
- Currency handling

**Deliverable:** Tool definitions document in BookStack

comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets

comments.text:
Implement action=create for Transfers.

Payload

- from_account_id, to_account_id, amount, date
- memo? (string)

Rules

- Accounts exist and belong to same family
- Amount positive; create two linked transactions; zero-sum

Result

- { ok: true, result: { debit_txn, credit_txn, link_id } }

Tests

- Happy: creates both sides; link recorded
- Edge: cross-family account rejected; not_found account

comments.text:
Summary:
Convert get_transactions with optional filters and robust validation.

Implementation Notes:

- Args: optional account_id (string), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (int, max 500)
- Query joins(:account).where(accounts.family_id = family_id); apply filters; includes(:category) to avoid N+1
- Output: [{id, date ISO8601, amount string, name, category}]
- Validate date order (start <= end) and limit bounds

Tasks:

1. Implement FastMcp::Tool subclass with argument validations
2. Apply limit capping; parse dates
3. Register tool; add integration tests for filters and bounds

Acceptance Criteria:

- Correct filtering; limit enforced; invalid date range errors
- P95 under 500ms on 10k txn dataset (baseline)

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-13, SFMCP-21, SFMCP-25 (perf follow-up)

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1652

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

Huly Issue: SFMCP-153

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=move for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- new_parent_id (uuid|null, required)

Rules

- Enforce depth <= 2 and classification match
- Cross-family forbidden
- Update color inheritance for moved subtree

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (depth limit, classification mismatch)
- not_found (ids)
- forbidden (cross-family)

Tests

- Happy: move root -> child of root; child -> root
- Edge: attempt to create third-level rejected; move to other-family parent rejected

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1611

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Summary:
Convert get_transactions with optional filters and robust validation.

Implementation Notes:

- Args: optional account_id (string), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (int, max 500)
- Query joins(:account).where(accounts.family_id = family_id); apply filters; includes(:category) to avoid N+1
- Output: [{id, date ISO8601, amount string, name, category}]
- Validate date order (start <= end) and limit bounds

Tasks:

1. Implement FastMcp::Tool subclass with argument validations
2. Apply limit capping; parse dates
3. Register tool; add integration tests for filters and bounds

Acceptance Criteria:

- Correct filtering; limit enforced; invalid date range errors
- P95 under 500ms on 10k txn dataset (baseline)

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-13, SFMCP-21, SFMCP-25 (perf follow-up)

Huly Issue: SFMCP-508

title: Technology Stack Decision: Ruby + Official MCP SDK

comments.author: node
comments.text:
**Decision:** Use Ruby 3.4.4 with official MCP SDK from modelcontextprotocol/ruby-sdk

**Rationale:**

- SureFinance is a Ruby on Rails project
- Official Ruby MCP SDK available (no need to implement protocol from scratch)
- Can leverage existing Rails infrastructure and models
- Familiar tooling and debugging
- Keep everything in one language

**Implementation:**

- Use MCP gem as dependency (not fork)
- Standalone server architecture
- HTTP transport (proven pattern)

**Status:** Approved

comments.text:
Design and document the initial set of MCP tools that the server will expose.

**Proposed Tools:**

1.  - List all accounts with balances
2.  - Query transactions with filters (date range, account, category)

4.  - Full-text search across transactions
5.  - List budgets with spending vs targets
6.  - List transaction categories

**Considerations:**

- Authentication/authorization (family scope)
- Rate limiting
- Pagination for large result sets
- Date range filtering
- Currency handling

**Deliverable:** Tool definitions document in BookStack

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1785

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=move for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- new_parent_id (uuid|null, required)

Rules

- Enforce depth <= 2 and classification match
- Cross-family forbidden
- Update color inheritance for moved subtree

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (depth limit, classification mismatch)
- not_found (ids)
- forbidden (cross-family)

Tests

- Happy: move root -> child of root; child -> root
- Edge: attempt to create third-level rejected; move to other-family parent rejected

Huly Issue: SFMCP-2106

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

- close/reopen: active state toggles; dates set

Huly Issue: SFMCP-711

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

title: EPIC: Phase 1 - Critical Validation & Error Handling

comments.author: node
comments.text:
**Goal:** Ensure all validation errors return proper error responses (not 500/internal)

**Scope:**

- Standardize error response structure across all tools
- Fix budget operations returning internal errors
- Fix holdings create returning internal errors
- Verify account operations accept integer values

**Success Criteria:**

- All validation errors return type: validation_error with field details
- Budget create with Nov-2025 returns validation_error (not internal)
- Holdings create with invalid data returns validation_error
- Account create accepts integer opening_balance

**Blocked by:** None
**Blocks:** Phase 2, Phase 3 issues

**Timeline:** Week 1 (5 days)

Huly Issue: SFMCP-212

title: Replace server.rb routing with FastMcp::Server and RackAdapter

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Summary:
Replace custom routing in server.rb with a FastMcp::Server instance mounted at /mcp via FastMcp::RackAdapter. Preserve /health.

Tasks:

1. Initialize FastMcp::Server (name, version)
2. Mount via Rack::Builder: map "/mcp" { run FastMcp::RackAdapter.new(server: mcp_server) }
3. Keep /health endpoint returning {status:"ok"}
4. Preserve logger, DB initialization, and env-based host/port
5. Wire tool registration (temporary no-op until SFMCP-14+)

Acceptance Criteria:

- POST /mcp with method tools/list returns JSON-RPC envelope (even if empty until tools are registered)
- /health returns 200 and JSON body
- No custom Tools::HttpHandler routing remains active for /mcp

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-11 (harness), SFMCP-13 (template for registration)

Out of Scope:

- Tool conversion itself

title: Define initial MCP tools for financial data access

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Design and document the initial set of MCP tools that the server will expose.

**Proposed Tools:**

1.  - List all accounts with balances
2.  - Query transactions with filters (date range, account, category)
3.  - Time series balance data for charts
4.  - Full-text search across transactions
5.  - List budgets with spending vs targets
6.  - List transaction categories

**Considerations:**

- Authentication/authorization (family scope)
- Rate limiting
- Pagination for large result sets
- Date range filtering
- Currency handling

**Deliverable:** Tool definitions document in BookStack

title: EPIC: Phase 2 - Input Coercion & Schema Hardening

comments.author: node
comments.text:
**Goal:** Accept integers, floats, and numeric strings uniformly; standardize serialization

**Scope:**

- Create number coercion helper in BaseTool
- Update all handlers to coerce numeric inputs
- Standardize numeric serialization (avoid exponential notation)
- Update schema definitions to accept all numeric types

**Success Criteria:**

- All numeric fields accept int/float/string
- All numeric responses use decimal notation ("100.50" not 1.005e2)
- Validation errors for non-numeric strings
- Zero "must be a float" errors

**Depends on:** Phase 1 completion
**Blocks:** Phase 3 issues

**Timeline:** Week 2 (5 days)

Huly Issue: SFMCP-465

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=move for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- new_parent_id (uuid|null, required)

Rules

- Enforce depth <= 2 and classification match
- Cross-family forbidden
- Update color inheritance for moved subtree

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (depth limit, classification mismatch)
- not_found (ids)
- forbidden (cross-family)

Tests

- Happy: move root -> child of root; child -> root
- Edge: attempt to create third-level rejected; move to other-family parent rejected

Huly Issue: SFMCP-2186

title: Define initial MCP tools for financial data access

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Design and document the initial set of MCP tools that the server will expose.

**Proposed Tools:**

1.  - List all accounts with balances
2.  - Query transactions with filters (date range, account, category)
3.  - Time series balance data for charts
4.  - Full-text search across transactions
5.  - List budgets with spending vs targets
6.  - List transaction categories

**Considerations:**

- Authentication/authorization (family scope)
- Rate limiting
- Pagination for large result sets
- Date range filtering
- Currency handling

**Deliverable:** Tool definitions document in BookStack

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1702

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

Server startup fails with NoMethodError when trying to set server_context on BaseTool module. Need to refactor the context injection pattern to work with module architecture.

## Root Cause

The current implementation tries to call  but BaseTool is a module, not a class. Module singleton methods need different handling.

## Current Implementation



## Proposed Solutions

### Option 1: Thread-local storage



### Option 2: Class variable with accessor



### Option 3: Tool instance injection



## Tasks

- [ ] Choose appropriate pattern for module-level state
- [ ] Update BaseTool module implementation
- [ ] Update server.rb to use new pattern
- [ ] Test server startup
- [ ] Verify all 6 tools can access context
- [ ] Add tests for context injection

## Acceptance Criteria

- Server starts without errors
- All tools can access family_id from context
- All tools can access logger from context
- All tools can access database from context

Huly Issue: SFMCP-467

title: [Tool] category_ops: create | update | move | delete | merge

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement a consolidated Categories tool with actions: create, update, move, delete, merge. Enforce family scoping, two-level hierarchy, classification match, and color inheritance. Integrate Idempotency/Audit wrappers. No HTTP mirrors in this phase.

Scope

- Fast-MCP tool  with  enum and action-specific payload validation
- Domain services under  with dispatcher
- DB transactions + FOR UPDATE for move/merge/delete

Acceptance Criteria

- create: name/classification; optional parent_id/lucide_icon/color (root only); validations enforced; returns {category}
- update: id; name?/lucide_icon?/color?[root only]; classification reclassify disallowed with children/links
- move: id,new_parent_id; depth<=2; classification match; subtree color inheritance updated
- delete: id,replacement_category_id?; uses replace_and_destroy!; reassigned_count returned
- merge: source_id,target_id; move txns; rewire budget_categories safely; delete source
- Errors mapped to taxonomy with field details
- Unit + integration tests (MCP): happy paths and edge cases
- Docs: example payloads and responses

Priority: HIGH (per guidance)
Milestone: v2.0-migration
Components: Tools, Testing, Documentation

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1431

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Summary:
Convert get_transactions with optional filters and robust validation.

Implementation Notes:

- Args: optional account_id (string), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (int, max 500)
- Query joins(:account).where(accounts.family_id = family_id); apply filters; includes(:category) to avoid N+1
- Output: [{id, date ISO8601, amount string, name, category}]
- Validate date order (start <= end) and limit bounds

Tasks:

1. Implement FastMcp::Tool subclass with argument validations
2. Apply limit capping; parse dates
3. Register tool; add integration tests for filters and bounds

Acceptance Criteria:

- Correct filtering; limit enforced; invalid date range errors
- P95 under 500ms on 10k txn dataset (baseline)

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-13, SFMCP-21, SFMCP-25 (perf follow-up)

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1722

title: Define initial MCP tools for financial data access

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Design and document the initial set of MCP tools that the server will expose.

**Proposed Tools:**

1.  - List all accounts with balances
2.  - Query transactions with filters (date range, account, category)
3.  - Time series balance data for charts
4.  - Full-text search across transactions
5.  - List budgets with spending vs targets
6.  - List transaction categories

**Considerations:**

- Authentication/authorization (family scope)
- Rate limiting
- Pagination for large result sets
- Date range filtering
- Currency handling

**Deliverable:** Tool definitions document in BookStack

- Update color inheritance for moved subtree

- validation_error (depth limit, classification mismatch)
- not_found (ids)
- forbidden (cross-family)

Tests

- Happy: move root -> child of root; child -> root
- Edge: attempt to create third-level rejected; move to other-family parent rejected

comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1848

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1974

title: [Tool] budget_ops: create | update | delete | assign_category | remove_category | progress

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement consolidated Budgets tool with actions: create, update, delete, assign_category, remove_category, progress. Enforce family scoping and model invariants. Integrate Idempotency/Audit. No HTTP mirrors this phase.

Scope

- Fast-MCP tool  with validated action payloads
- Services under  with dispatcher
- Use Budget.find_or_bootstrap for create; progress via helpers

Acceptance Criteria

- create: month/start_date; default currency from family; bootstrap + sync
- update: id; budgeted_spending?/expected_income? (non-negative)
- delete: id; destroyed true
- assign_category: budget_id,category_id,budgeted_spending?; create-or-update BudgetCategory
- remove_category: budget_id,category_id; removed true
- progress: id; overall + per-category metrics
- Errors mapped to taxonomy
- Unit + integration tests (MCP)
- Docs: examples

Priority: HIGH
Milestone: v2.0-migration
Components: Tools, Testing, Documentation

Huly Issue: SFMCP-2192

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=merge for Categories.

Payload

- source_id (uuid, required)
- target_id (uuid, required)

Rules

- Same family and classification
- Move all transactions from source to target
- Rewire budget_categories; handle unique(budget_id, category_id)
- Destroy source after move

Result

- { ok: true, result: { merged: true, moved_transactions: N, moved_budget_categories: M } }

Errors

- conflict (budget category uniqueness)
- validation_error (classification mismatch)
- not_found (ids)

Tests

- Happy: merge two expense categories; merge two income categories
- Edge: classification mismatch rejected; budget_category conflict resolved gracefully

comments.text:
Summary:
Convert get_transactions with optional filters and robust validation.

Implementation Notes:

- Args: optional account_id (string), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (int, max 500)
- Query joins(:account).where(accounts.family_id = family_id); apply filters; includes(:category) to avoid N+1
- Output: [{id, date ISO8601, amount string, name, category}]
- Validate date order (start <= end) and limit bounds

Tasks:

1. Implement FastMcp::Tool subclass with argument validations
2. Apply limit capping; parse dates
3. Register tool; add integration tests for filters and bounds

Acceptance Criteria:

- Correct filtering; limit enforced; invalid date range errors
- P95 under 500ms on 10k txn dataset (baseline)

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-13, SFMCP-21, SFMCP-25 (perf follow-up)

comments.text:
## Problem

The MCP server is creating Entry records with invalid  values that include the full namespace path () instead of the correct Rails model name ().

## Impact

- **Severity**: CRITICAL - Causes application crashes
- **Affected**: Account detail pages return "something went wrong" errors
- **Records Corrupted**: 8 Entry records across Chequing and Savings accounts

## Root Cause

When creating Entry records, the tool is using the full class namespace instead of the Rails model name:



## Fix Required

1. Update Entry creation code to use correct class names:
   - Use  not 
   - Use  not full namespace
2. Add validation to prevent incorrect namespaces
3. Add tests to verify correct entryable_type values

- conflict (budget category uniqueness)

- Happy: merge two expense categories; merge two income categories

- validation_error (locked/default category)
- not_found (ids)
- conflict (has subcategories without policy)

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1804

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1661

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

## Problem

The MCP server is creating Entry records with invalid  values that include the full namespace path () instead of the correct Rails model name ().

## Impact

- **Severity**: CRITICAL - Causes application crashes
- **Affected**: Account detail pages return "something went wrong" errors
- **Records Corrupted**: 8 Entry records across Chequing and Savings accounts

## Root Cause

When creating Entry records, the tool is using the full class namespace instead of the Rails model name:



## Fix Required

1. Update Entry creation code to use correct class names:
   - Use  not 
   - Use  not full namespace
2. Add validation to prevent incorrect namespaces
3. Add tests to verify correct entryable_type values

comments.text:
Implement action=create for Categories.

Payload

- name (string, required)
- classification ("income"|"expense", required)
- parent_id (uuid|null)
- lucide_icon (string|null)
- color (hex|null; root only; if parent_id present, ignore and inherit)

Rules

- Name unique per family; presence required
- If parent_id present: same family, same classification, depth <= 2; color = parent.color

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (duplicate name, depth limit, bad classification)
- not_found (parent)
- forbidden (parent from other family)

Tests

- Happy: root income; child expense inherits color
- Edge: dup name in family; parent mismatch classification; depth>2 rejected

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Summary:
Convert get_transactions with optional filters and robust validation.

Implementation Notes:

- Args: optional account_id (string), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (int, max 500)
- Query joins(:account).where(accounts.family_id = family_id); apply filters; includes(:category) to avoid N+1
- Output: [{id, date ISO8601, amount string, name, category}]
- Validate date order (start <= end) and limit bounds

Tasks:

1. Implement FastMcp::Tool subclass with argument validations
2. Apply limit capping; parse dates
3. Register tool; add integration tests for filters and bounds

Acceptance Criteria:

- Correct filtering; limit enforced; invalid date range errors
- P95 under 500ms on 10k txn dataset (baseline)

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-13, SFMCP-21, SFMCP-25 (perf follow-up)

Huly Issue: SFMCP-2022

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

- id (uuid, required)
- new_parent_id (uuid|null, required)

- Enforce depth <= 2 and classification match
- Cross-family forbidden
- Update color inheritance for moved subtree

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (depth limit, classification mismatch)
- not_found (ids)
- forbidden (cross-family)

Tests

- Happy: move root -> child of root; child -> root
- Edge: attempt to create third-level rejected; move to other-family parent rejected

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1465

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

Huly Issue: SFMCP-2012

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Summary:
Convert get_transactions with optional filters and robust validation.

Implementation Notes:

- Args: optional account_id (string), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (int, max 500)
- Query joins(:account).where(accounts.family_id = family_id); apply filters; includes(:category) to avoid N+1
- Output: [{id, date ISO8601, amount string, name, category}]
- Validate date order (start <= end) and limit bounds

Tasks:

1. Implement FastMcp::Tool subclass with argument validations
2. Apply limit capping; parse dates
3. Register tool; add integration tests for filters and bounds

Acceptance Criteria:

- Correct filtering; limit enforced; invalid date range errors
- P95 under 500ms on 10k txn dataset (baseline)

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-13, SFMCP-21, SFMCP-25 (perf follow-up)

title: Replace server.rb routing with FastMcp::Server and RackAdapter

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Summary:
Replace custom routing in server.rb with a FastMcp::Server instance mounted at /mcp via FastMcp::RackAdapter. Preserve /health.

Tasks:

1. Initialize FastMcp::Server (name, version)
2. Mount via Rack::Builder: map "/mcp" { run FastMcp::RackAdapter.new(server: mcp_server) }
3. Keep /health endpoint returning {status:"ok"}
4. Preserve logger, DB initialization, and env-based host/port
5. Wire tool registration (temporary no-op until SFMCP-14+)

Acceptance Criteria:

- POST /mcp with method tools/list returns JSON-RPC envelope (even if empty until tools are registered)
- /health returns 200 and JSON body
- No custom Tools::HttpHandler routing remains active for /mcp

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-11 (harness), SFMCP-13 (template for registration)

Out of Scope:

- Tool conversion itself

title: Define initial MCP tools for financial data access

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Design and document the initial set of MCP tools that the server will expose.

**Proposed Tools:**

1.  - List all accounts with balances
2.  - Query transactions with filters (date range, account, category)
3.  - Time series balance data for charts
4.  - Full-text search across transactions
5.  - List budgets with spending vs targets
6.  - List transaction categories

**Considerations:**

- Authentication/authorization (family scope)
- Rate limiting
- Pagination for large result sets
- Date range filtering
- Currency handling

**Deliverable:** Tool definitions document in BookStack

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1942

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=create for Categories.

Payload

- name (string, required)
- classification ("income"|"expense", required)
- parent_id (uuid|null)
- lucide_icon (string|null)
- color (hex|null; root only; if parent_id present, ignore and inherit)

Rules

- Name unique per family; presence required
- If parent_id present: same family, same classification, depth <= 2; color = parent.color

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (duplicate name, depth limit, bad classification)
- not_found (parent)
- forbidden (parent from other family)

Tests

- Happy: root income; child expense inherits color
- Edge: dup name in family; parent mismatch classification; depth>2 rejected

Design and document the initial set of MCP tools that the server will expose.

**Proposed Tools:**

1.  - List all accounts with balances
2.  - Query transactions with filters (date range, account, category)
3.  - Time series balance data for charts
4.  - Full-text search across transactions
5.  - List budgets with spending vs targets
6.  - List transaction categories

**Considerations:**

- Authentication/authorization (family scope)
- Rate limiting
- Pagination for large result sets
- Date range filtering
- Currency handling

**Deliverable:** Tool definitions document in BookStack

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1742

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=move for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- new_parent_id (uuid|null, required)

Rules

- Enforce depth <= 2 and classification match
- Cross-family forbidden
- Update color inheritance for moved subtree

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (depth limit, classification mismatch)
- not_found (ids)
- forbidden (cross-family)

Tests

- Happy: move root -> child of root; child -> root
- Edge: attempt to create third-level rejected; move to other-family parent rejected

Summary:
Convert get_transactions with optional filters and robust validation.

Implementation Notes:

- Args: optional account_id (string), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (int, max 500)
- Query joins(:account).where(accounts.family_id = family_id); apply filters; includes(:category) to avoid N+1
- Output: [{id, date ISO8601, amount string, name, category}]
- Validate date order (start <= end) and limit bounds

Tasks:

1. Implement FastMcp::Tool subclass with argument validations
2. Apply limit capping; parse dates
3. Register tool; add integration tests for filters and bounds

Acceptance Criteria:

- Correct filtering; limit enforced; invalid date range errors
- P95 under 500ms on 10k txn dataset (baseline)

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-13, SFMCP-21, SFMCP-25 (perf follow-up)

- Args: optional account_id (string), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (int, max 500)
- Query joins(:account).where(accounts.family_id = family_id); apply filters; includes(:category) to avoid N+1
- Output: [{id, date ISO8601, amount string, name, category}]
- Validate date order (start <= end) and limit bounds

Tasks:

1. Implement FastMcp::Tool subclass with argument validations
2. Apply limit capping; parse dates
3. Register tool; add integration tests for filters and bounds

Acceptance Criteria:

- Correct filtering; limit enforced; invalid date range errors
- P95 under 500ms on 10k txn dataset (baseline)

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-13, SFMCP-21, SFMCP-25 (perf follow-up)

Huly Issue: SFMCP-70

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)

- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Summary:
Convert get_transactions with optional filters and robust validation.

Implementation Notes:

- Args: optional account_id (string), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (int, max 500)
- Query joins(:account).where(accounts.family_id = family_id); apply filters; includes(:category) to avoid N+1
- Output: [{id, date ISO8601, amount string, name, category}]
- Validate date order (start <= end) and limit bounds

Tasks:

1. Implement FastMcp::Tool subclass with argument validations
2. Apply limit capping; parse dates
3. Register tool; add integration tests for filters and bounds

Acceptance Criteria:

- Correct filtering; limit enforced; invalid date range errors
- P95 under 500ms on 10k txn dataset (baseline)

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-13, SFMCP-21, SFMCP-25 (perf follow-up)

Huly Issue: SFMCP-2230

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

Huly Issue: SFMCP-2187

title: Define initial MCP tools for financial data access

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Design and document the initial set of MCP tools that the server will expose.

**Proposed Tools:**

1.  - List all accounts with balances
2.  - Query transactions with filters (date range, account, category)
3.  - Time series balance data for charts
4.  - Full-text search across transactions
5.  - List budgets with spending vs targets
6.  - List transaction categories

**Considerations:**

- Authentication/authorization (family scope)
- Rate limiting
- Pagination for large result sets
- Date range filtering
- Currency handling

**Deliverable:** Tool definitions document in BookStack

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1883

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

Huly Issue: SFMCP-77

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Summary:
Convert get_transactions with optional filters and robust validation.

Implementation Notes:

- Args: optional account_id (string), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (int, max 500)
- Query joins(:account).where(accounts.family_id = family_id); apply filters; includes(:category) to avoid N+1
- Output: [{id, date ISO8601, amount string, name, category}]
- Validate date order (start <= end) and limit bounds

Tasks:

1. Implement FastMcp::Tool subclass with argument validations
2. Apply limit capping; parse dates
3. Register tool; add integration tests for filters and bounds

Acceptance Criteria:

- Correct filtering; limit enforced; invalid date range errors
- P95 under 500ms on 10k txn dataset (baseline)

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-13, SFMCP-21, SFMCP-25 (perf follow-up)

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)

Rules

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

title: Define initial MCP tools for financial data access

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Design and document the initial set of MCP tools that the server will expose.

**Proposed Tools:**

1.  - List all accounts with balances
2.  - Query transactions with filters (date range, account, category)
3.  - Time series balance data for charts
4.  - Full-text search across transactions
5.  - List budgets with spending vs targets
6.  - List transaction categories

**Considerations:**

- Authentication/authorization (family scope)
- Rate limiting
- Pagination for large result sets
- Date range filtering
- Currency handling

**Deliverable:** Tool definitions document in BookStack

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Summary:
Convert get_transactions with optional filters and robust validation.

Implementation Notes:

- Args: optional account_id (string), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (int, max 500)
- Query joins(:account).where(accounts.family_id = family_id); apply filters; includes(:category) to avoid N+1
- Output: [{id, date ISO8601, amount string, name, category}]
- Validate date order (start <= end) and limit bounds

Tasks:

1. Implement FastMcp::Tool subclass with argument validations
2. Apply limit capping; parse dates
3. Register tool; add integration tests for filters and bounds

Acceptance Criteria:

- Correct filtering; limit enforced; invalid date range errors
- P95 under 500ms on 10k txn dataset (baseline)

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-13, SFMCP-21, SFMCP-25 (perf follow-up)

comments.text:
Summary:
Convert get_transactions with optional filters and robust validation.

Implementation Notes:

- Args: optional account_id (string), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (int, max 500)
- Query joins(:account).where(accounts.family_id = family_id); apply filters; includes(:category) to avoid N+1
- Output: [{id, date ISO8601, amount string, name, category}]
- Validate date order (start <= end) and limit bounds

Tasks:

1. Implement FastMcp::Tool subclass with argument validations
2. Apply limit capping; parse dates
3. Register tool; add integration tests for filters and bounds

Acceptance Criteria:

- Correct filtering; limit enforced; invalid date range errors
- P95 under 500ms on 10k txn dataset (baseline)

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-13, SFMCP-21, SFMCP-25 (perf follow-up)

Huly Issue: SFMCP-2083

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=move for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- new_parent_id (uuid|null, required)

Rules

- Enforce depth <= 2 and classification match
- Cross-family forbidden
- Update color inheritance for moved subtree

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (depth limit, classification mismatch)
- not_found (ids)
- forbidden (cross-family)

Tests

- Happy: move root -> child of root; child -> root
- Edge: attempt to create third-level rejected; move to other-family parent rejected

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1902

title: Define initial MCP tools for financial data access

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Design and document the initial set of MCP tools that the server will expose.

**Proposed Tools:**

1.  - List all accounts with balances
2.  - Query transactions with filters (date range, account, category)
3.  - Time series balance data for charts
4.  - Full-text search across transactions
5.  - List budgets with spending vs targets
6.  - List transaction categories

**Considerations:**

- Authentication/authorization (family scope)
- Rate limiting
- Pagination for large result sets
- Date range filtering
- Currency handling

**Deliverable:** Tool definitions document in BookStack

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1717

title: CRITICAL: NULL currency values in Entry records cause crashes

comments.author: node
comments.text:
## Problem

The MCP server is creating Entry records without setting the required  field, leaving it as NULL. This violates database constraints and causes application crashes.

## Impact

- **Severity**: CRITICAL - Causes application crashes
- **Affected**: Account pages fail to load with "something went wrong" errors
- **Records Corrupted**: 8 Entry records with NULL currency values

## Root Cause

When creating Entry records, the tool is not setting the required  field:



## Fix Required

1. **Always set currency field** when creating Entry records
2. Use account's currency as default: 
3. Add validation to ensure currency is never NULL
4. Add tests for currency field presence

## Detection Script



## Required Fields for Entry Model

-  - UUID, NOT NULL
- Mon Dec 22 23:40:30 UTC 2025 - Date, NOT NULL
-  - Decimal, NOT NULL
-  - String (3 chars), NOT NULL ⚠️
-  - String, NOT NULL
-  - UUID, NOT NULL

comments.text:
Summary:
Convert get_transactions with optional filters and robust validation.

Implementation Notes:

- Args: optional account_id (string), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (int, max 500)
- Query joins(:account).where(accounts.family_id = family_id); apply filters; includes(:category) to avoid N+1
- Output: [{id, date ISO8601, amount string, name, category}]
- Validate date order (start <= end) and limit bounds

Tasks:

1. Implement FastMcp::Tool subclass with argument validations
2. Apply limit capping; parse dates
3. Register tool; add integration tests for filters and bounds

Acceptance Criteria:

- Correct filtering; limit enforced; invalid date range errors
- P95 under 500ms on 10k txn dataset (baseline)

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-13, SFMCP-21, SFMCP-25 (perf follow-up)

Acceptance Criteria:

- At least one converted tool (SFMCP-14) uses the base module/class
- docs/tool_template.md exists and matches implementation

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-12, SFMCP-21

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Design auth mechanism for MCP server access.

**Requirements:**

- Secure access to financial data
- Family-scoped data access (respect Current.family)
- Support for multiple authentication methods
- Rate limiting per client

**Options:**

1. API keys (simple, good for trusted clients)
2. OAuth2 (complex, industry standard)
3. JWT tokens (stateless, scalable)
4. Session-based (if integrated with Rails)

**Considerations:**

- Claude Code will be primary client initially
- May need to support other MCP clients later
- Should integrate with existing SureFinance auth if possible

**Deliverable:** Auth design document in BookStack

5.  - List budgets with spending vs targets
6.  - List transaction categories

**Considerations:**

- Authentication/authorization (family scope)
- Rate limiting
- Pagination for large result sets
- Date range filtering
- Currency handling

**Deliverable:** Tool definitions document in BookStack

Huly Issue: SFMCP-2045

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

comments.text:
Summary:
Convert get_transactions with optional filters and robust validation.

Implementation Notes:

- Args: optional account_id (string), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (int, max 500)
- Query joins(:account).where(accounts.family_id = family_id); apply filters; includes(:category) to avoid N+1
- Output: [{id, date ISO8601, amount string, name, category}]
- Validate date order (start <= end) and limit bounds

Tasks:

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1780

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Summary:
Convert get_transactions with optional filters and robust validation.

Implementation Notes:

- Args: optional account_id (string), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (int, max 500)
- Query joins(:account).where(accounts.family_id = family_id); apply filters; includes(:category) to avoid N+1
- Output: [{id, date ISO8601, amount string, name, category}]
- Validate date order (start <= end) and limit bounds

Tasks:

1. Implement FastMcp::Tool subclass with argument validations
2. Apply limit capping; parse dates
3. Register tool; add integration tests for filters and bounds

Acceptance Criteria:

- Correct filtering; limit enforced; invalid date range errors
- P95 under 500ms on 10k txn dataset (baseline)

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-13, SFMCP-21, SFMCP-25 (perf follow-up)

title: Define initial MCP tools for financial data access

comments.text:
Design and document the initial set of MCP tools that the server will expose.

**Proposed Tools:**

1.  - List all accounts with balances
2.  - Query transactions with filters (date range, account, category)
3.  - Time series balance data for charts
4.  - Full-text search across transactions
5.  - List budgets with spending vs targets
6.  - List transaction categories

**Considerations:**

- Authentication/authorization (family scope)
- Rate limiting
- Pagination for large result sets
- Date range filtering
- Currency handling

**Deliverable:** Tool definitions document in BookStack

Huly Issue: SFMCP-2065

title: Define initial MCP tools for financial data access

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Design and document the initial set of MCP tools that the server will expose.

**Proposed Tools:**

1.  - List all accounts with balances
2.  - Query transactions with filters (date range, account, category)
3.  - Time series balance data for charts
4.  - Full-text search across transactions
5.  - List budgets with spending vs targets
6.  - List transaction categories

**Considerations:**

- Authentication/authorization (family scope)
- Rate limiting
- Pagination for large result sets
- Date range filtering
- Currency handling

**Deliverable:** Tool definitions document in BookStack

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=create for Transfers.

Payload

- from_account_id, to_account_id, amount, date
- memo? (string)

Rules

- Accounts exist and belong to same family
- Amount positive; create two linked transactions; zero-sum

Result

- { ok: true, result: { debit_txn, credit_txn, link_id } }

Tests

- Happy: creates both sides; link recorded
- Edge: cross-family account rejected; not_found account

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1529

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=move for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- new_parent_id (uuid|null, required)

Rules

- Enforce depth <= 2 and classification match
- Cross-family forbidden
- Update color inheritance for moved subtree

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (depth limit, classification mismatch)
- not_found (ids)
- forbidden (cross-family)

Tests

- Happy: move root -> child of root; child -> root
- Edge: attempt to create third-level rejected; move to other-family parent rejected

Huly Issue: SFMCP-106

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Summary:
Provide a reusable base and examples to accelerate tool conversion to FastMcp::Tool.

Deliverables:

- lib/surefinance_mcp/tools/base_tool.rb (or module) providing:
  -  helper,  accessor with family_id
  - Common error handling helper (translate exceptions to error hashes if needed)
- docs/tool_template.md: Template with arguments block, call, and response pattern

Tasks:

1. Implement base module/class mixing in to FastMcp::Tool subclasses
2. Ensure family_id comes from a single place (ENV or injected context, per SFMCP-21)
3. Include example for enum validations and date parsing

Acceptance Criteria:

- At least one converted tool (SFMCP-14) uses the base module/class
- docs/tool_template.md exists and matches implementation

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-12, SFMCP-21

title: Create number coercion helper in BaseTool

comments.author: node
comments.text:
**Problem:** Numeric fields reject integers and strings, causing validation errors.

**Solution:**
Add coercion helpers to :



**Benefits:**

- Accepts int, float, numeric string
- Returns BigDecimal for precision
- Clear error messages
- Avoids exponential notation in output

**Testing:**

- Test with integers: 100
- Test with floats: 100.50
- Test with strings: "100.50"
- Test with invalid: "abc" → ArgumentError

**Estimated:** 3 hours
**Parent:** SFMCP-[EPIC-2]

Convert get_account_balance_history to FastMcp::Tool with required account_id and optional range enum.

- Args: required account_id (string); optional range in ["30d","90d","1y"]
- Validate account belongs to family_id; 404-style error if not found
- Query AccountBalanceHistory by date range; order by date asc
- Output: {account_id, account_name, range, balances:[{date, balance}]}

Tasks:

1. Implement arguments block with required(:account_id), optional(:range, enum)
2. Validate ownership; map errors consistently (error field or raise)
3. Register tool; add tests for valid/invalid args

Acceptance Criteria:

- JSON-RPC call validates args; returns balances
- Invalid account_id returns clear error

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-13, SFMCP-21

comments.text:
Implement action=move for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- new_parent_id (uuid|null, required)

Rules

- Enforce depth <= 2 and classification match
- Cross-family forbidden
- Update color inheritance for moved subtree

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (depth limit, classification mismatch)
- not_found (ids)
- forbidden (cross-family)

Tests

- Happy: move root -> child of root; child -> root
- Edge: attempt to create third-level rejected; move to other-family parent rejected

comments.text:
Implement action=move for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- new_parent_id (uuid|null, required)

Rules

- Enforce depth <= 2 and classification match
- Cross-family forbidden
- Update color inheritance for moved subtree

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (depth limit, classification mismatch)
- not_found (ids)
- forbidden (cross-family)

Tests

- Happy: move root -> child of root; child -> root
- Edge: attempt to create third-level rejected; move to other-family parent rejected

comments.text:

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)

Rules

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

Summary:
Convert get_transactions with optional filters and robust validation.

Implementation Notes:

- Args: optional account_id (string), start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (int, max 500)
- Query joins(:account).where(accounts.family_id = family_id); apply filters; includes(:category) to avoid N+1
- Output: [{id, date ISO8601, amount string, name, category}]
- Validate date order (start <= end) and limit bounds

Tasks:

1. Implement FastMcp::Tool subclass with argument validations
2. Apply limit capping; parse dates
3. Register tool; add integration tests for filters and bounds

Acceptance Criteria:

- Correct filtering; limit enforced; invalid date range errors
- P95 under 500ms on 10k txn dataset (baseline)

Dependencies:

- SFMCP-13, SFMCP-21, SFMCP-25 (perf follow-up)

**Goal:** Consistent idempotency enforcement and atomic multi-record operations

- Enforce idempotency keys on all write operations

- Ensure transfer atomicity with proper rollback

- Creating same resource twice with idempotency_key returns same result
- Budget create without key returns existing if duplicate

- All write operations support idempotency

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1809

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

Huly Issue: SFMCP-43

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=create for Transfers.

Payload

- from_account_id, to_account_id, amount, date
- memo? (string)

Rules

- Accounts exist and belong to same family
- Amount positive; create two linked transactions; zero-sum

Result

- { ok: true, result: { debit_txn, credit_txn, link_id } }

Tests

- Happy: creates both sides; link recorded
- Edge: cross-family account rejected; not_found account

Huly Issue: SFMCP-1881

comments.author: node
comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected

comments.text:
Implement action=update for Categories.

Payload

- id (uuid, required)
- name? (string)
- lucide_icon? (string)
- color? (hex; only for root categories)

Rules

- Reclassification change not supported by default; disallow if children or linked txns/budgets
- Color changes propagate to children (inheritance)

Result

- { ok: true, result: { category: {...} } }

Errors

- validation_error (invalid color for child, blank name)
- not_found (id)
- conflict (attempt to reclassify with children/links)

Tests

- Happy: rename root, change icon; change root color propagates
- Edge: update color on child rejected; rename to duplicate rejected
